label: Baptist (general)
framing: Frame for a Baptist audience (non-SBC): Scripture, personal faith in Christ, believer’s baptism, congregational polity, and evangelism. Prefer New Hampshire Baptist Confession (1833) or 1689 London Baptist Confession identifiers—not BF&M unless the SBC pack is selected. Do not invent confession dumps.
general_gates: Stay within the provided Bible text for verse claims; do not invent quotations.
Do not invent primary-source citations beyond the digests and Baptist confession identifiers supplied in this pack.
When citing Baptist doctrine for this general pack, prefer New Hampshire Baptist Confession or 1689 London Baptist Confession Art. numbers—not BF&M (use the SBC pack for BF&M).
When a doctrinal stance gate matches, state the tradition, the stance (yes/no/conditional/pastoral/silence), and any required conditions clearly.
For sensitive life topics, encourage prayer and trusted pastoral or professional help; AI is not a substitute for counseling.

citation_map.note: Of the Scriptures — Bible as inspired and sufficient rule of faith. Cite Art. 1 (1833). Reformed Baptists may also cite 1689 LBC ch. 1.
Fall of Man; Way of Salvation; Justification by grace through faith. Cite Arts. 4–6.
Baptism and the Lord’s Supper as ordinances. Believer’s immersion is Baptist practice. Cite Arts. 14–15.
Of a Gospel Church — congregational. Cite Art. 13.
Of Marriage — lifelong covenant; pastoral care for divorce/remarriage. Cite 1689 LBC ch. 25 (often numbered in editions) / marriage teaching—paraphrase only.

primary_sources.title: Baptist confessions — Scripture (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: The Holy Bible is the only sufficient, certain, and authoritative rule of faith and practice. Historic Baptists also treasure the 1689 London Baptist Confession for Reformed Baptist congregations.

primary_sources.title: Baptist confessions — salvation (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: Salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ—personal conversion, not inherited church membership.

primary_sources.title: Baptist confessions — baptism & Lord’s Supper (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: Believer’s baptism by immersion and the Lord’s Supper are gospel ordinances of the local church—not a priestly sacramental system.

primary_sources.title: Baptist confessions — local church (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: A gospel church is a local congregation of baptized believers under Christ’s lordship with congregational responsibility.

stances.summary: Bible as sufficient rule of faith (NH Art. 1 / 1689 LBC ch. 1).
Speak as Lord’s Supper/ordinance, not Mass.
Grace through faith in Christ (NH Arts. 4–6).
Marriage as lifelong covenant under Scripture.
Serious under biblical teaching; pastoral counsel.
